remarks: Welcome to Rolling Ridge in Norwalk! This desirable first floor, corner-unit condo offers a spacious one-bedroom en suite with/ walk in closet, plus a versatile den that can easily serve as a second bedroom, home office, or guest space. The inviting living room flows into the eat-in kitchen, while the convenience of in-unit laundry makes everyday living a breeze. Step outside to your own private patio, located just off the den-the perfect spot for grilling, enjoying your morning coffee, or unwinding with your favorite book. An additional storage unit in a nearby building provides plenty of room for seasonal items and extra belongings. The HOA includes **HEAT and HOT WATER**-Residents also enjoy fantastic amenities, including an inground pool w/ large patio, clubhouse, tennis courts, and private dog park, making it easy to relax and stay active right at home. Whether you're a first-time homeowner, downsizing, or looking for a low-maintenance lifestyle, this charming condo is one you won't want to miss!  Why rent when you can own? Conveniently located just off Main Avenue with easy access to shopping, grocery stores, Merritt 7, the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and more. Come see all this condo has to offer!
